name: Glowfish Chess
author: Analog Hors
description: A simple game of chess against a basic CPU or a second player. D-pad to move the cursor, Z to select and move pieces, X to undo.

descriptions.en: A simple game of chess against a basic CPU or a second player. D-pad to move the cursor, Z to select and move pieces, X to undo.
descriptions.it: Una semplice partita a scacchi contro la CPU o contro un secondo giocatore. Frecce per il cursore, Z per scegliere e muovere i pezzi, X per annullare.
